Why Josefin

A capable system, built on a personal conviction.

Why this exists, who's behind it, and how it differs from other tools people reach for when life gets full.

From the founder

Why I started Josefin.

"The more people I spoke to, and the more of my friends' lives I observed, the more I noticed the same pattern: modern life quietly depends on someone remembering, carrying, holding everything.

The appointments. The deadlines. The birthday gift to the extended family member. The things that need chasing. All the details that hold a household together behind the scenes.

I started Josefin because I believe people deserve more support in their everyday lives — intelligent systems that can help things to run smoothly, keep people coordinated, and stop important details from slipping through the cracks. And most of all, provide people with some relief.

Something calm, capable, and genuinely helpful. Technology that understands the context around your life, helps carry the mental load, and quietly, but capably, keeps things moving."

Wande Abe
Founder & CEO
Background

The path that led
to this work.

The decision to build Josefin came from a really personal place — I looked around me and saw friends and family drowning under the weight of managing full-time jobs and their households. It felt overwhelming, stressful, and people were just trying to deal in their own way — with varying results.

Before I thought about building any code, I decided to live the solution. I became 'Josefin' for 2 months; manually serving households across London, Berlin, Cape Town and Lagos. 5 school emails a day of different lengths, detail and complexity. Children falling ill and rejecting weekly meal plans. Parents booking wrong flights. Calendar conflicts. Nanny coordination breakdowns. To-dos missed or forgotten.

I picked up on each issue, and thought through what households really need. Visibility. Coordination. Reminders and follow-ups. Execution. A shared system. That rigorous validation shaped everything about how Josefin works.

—  §  —

I spent the last 15 years solving consumer problems across industries - from building the non-flower gifting business at Bloom & Wild, to driving marketing and strategy at LVMH team, to getting into the nuts and bolts of consumer businesses at McKinsey.

But Josefin is different. This isn't about building another lifestyle brand or scaling a marketplace. It's about removing the sense of overwhelm, guilt and frustration that prevents people from being fully present in their lives, and enjoying their day-to-day.
